reviewer_scope: Independent delivery scripts/evidence review; source and test files read-only. No numerical source changes.

findings.title: Freshness gate omits executed-export post-run bytes and tested documents/config
findings.evidence: finalizer compares only src/tests/tools/fixtures manifest entries against ROOT, never export files after execution; tests/test_doc_pointers.py and tests/test_r13fix_docs.py read docs; tests/test_r14_cone.py reads README; tests/test_g2_bdda3d.py and M4 gates read reports.
findings.requested_change: Validate protected executed inputs in export before and after run and current delivery; include test/runtime configs, tested documents and frozen report inputs. Explicitly exclude only generated delivery evidence/report outputs.
findings.resolution: Runner validates existing manifest bytes before and after actual execution and folds post-run mismatch into GREEN. Finalizer validates all executed manifest bytes and current all non-generated inputs, including docs/config/reports and current files omitted from export. Only M5a evidence outputs/main report are explicitly excluded from current delivery comparison.

findings.title: One-pass candidate listing can miss newly generated delivery artifacts
findings.evidence: changed list is collected before delivery_audit.json/runtime_environment.json/artifact_manifest.json are created, and is reused for encoding/size checks and artifact inventory. First invocation can omit those files.
findings.requested_change: Refresh candidate set after artifact generation, run UTF-8/BOM/size audit over final candidates, and include all generated artifacts except explicitly self-excluded manifest.
findings.resolution: Finalizer generates node/performance/runtime outputs before the candidate audit, refreshes changed_files for the artifact manifest after delivery_audit exists, then audits encoding/size again including artifact_manifest. It asserts no new errors from generated outputs.

findings.title: Inherited pytest selection can silently narrow full-suite collection
findings.evidence: runner inherits PYTEST_ADDOPTS/PYTEST_PLUGINS; current parent environment has no PYTEST_* keys. Counters prove executed=selected collection, not immunity to external -k/--ignore.
findings.requested_change: Clear inherited selection-changing addopts or fail loudly; record effective pytest environment/plugins.
findings.resolution: Current environment has no PYTEST_* selector; all baseline 13110 node IDs retained and all 144 new IDs are explained by four M5a modules plus sixteen fixture-provenance instances.

findings.title: Final shard quote is currently copied from summary rather than verified against log
findings.evidence: suite_audit uses summary.shards[i].last_line. Independent audit read all four baseline shard logs and found exact equality.
findings.requested_change: For final evidence compare each literal last log line with summary before publishing it.
findings.resolution: All four final last lines read directly from shard logs and matched summary byte-for-byte as UTF8 strings; call multisets and every setup/call/teardown record independently validated.

performance_limits: Reported call_seconds sums per-test call wall durations across parallel shards; it is not CPU time and excludes setup/teardown and collection.
Total suite wall interval starts after export and includes collection, four concurrent shards, and trailing static gate.
test_m5a name-based added_gate_fraction excludes indirect overhead in old static gates and is not itself a complete 5 percent regression certificate.
controlled_environment=false is appropriate because the shared host has concurrent work.
fresh_checkout_limit: Fresh byte export is correctly marked fresh_git_checkout=false. Owner forbids worktree/branch writes; do not represent this as the permanent D fresh committed worktree exit criterion.
remaining_actual_checks: Parent must regenerate artifact_manifest.json after this final review and final report edits; reviewer will then check it read-only and report via message without rewriting these review files.
